name: expiry_day_pattern_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY and BANKNIFTY expiry days, option market makers who are short gamma at near-ATM strikes must delta-hedge: they buy the index on dips and sell on rallies relative to the strike cluster with maximum open interest (a proxy for max pain). In the morning session (09:20-13:30 IST), this creates a consistent magnetic pull — when NIFTY deviates 25+ spot points below the max-OI strike, market makers absorb selling and create a floor, reverting spot toward the pin level within 30-90 seconds; the mirror image holds when price is 25+ points above. In the final 90 minutes (13:30-15:25 IST), gamma decays toward zero and market makers unwind their delta hedges en masse: the pinning force collapses, and any directional push creates a rapid 30-60 second momentum burst as de-hedging amplifies the initial move rather than dampening it.
session: 09:20-15:25 IST (expiry days only — detected from option_df expiry == session_date)

other: open_interest per strike from option_df (to derive max-OI strike = max pain proxy)

indicators.name: is_expiry
indicators.formula: 1 if any option in option_df has expiry == session_date, else 0
indicators.purpose: Fires ONLY on expiry days — weekly Thursday NIFTY/BANKNIFTY or monthly last Thursday. The gamma dynamics and pinning mechanism require live expiry-day OI pressure; they do not exist on non-expiry days. Derived from option_df without any external calendar.

indicators.name: max_oi_strike
indicators.formula: argmax over strikes of (sum(CE OI, PE OI) using last OI reading per strike for session-date expiry options)
indicators.purpose: The strike with highest combined CE+PE open interest is where option sellers have the greatest notional exposure and thus the greatest incentive to pin. This is a computationally tractable proxy for max pain (the true max pain minimizes total option buyer P&L, which correlates strongly with max-OI strike). Computed once per day from option_df — no lookback needed since it is a cumulative OI snapshot.

indicators.name: dist_to_max_oi
indicators.purpose: Measures how far NIFTY/BANKNIFTY has strayed from the pinning target. The signal fires when |dist| > threshold (default 30 pts). At NIFTY ~22500, 30 pts = ~13 bps — approximately the 30 bps used in the original 1-min strategy but compressed to spot points for direct thresholding. Direction of dist determines CE vs PE entry.

indicators.name: mom_12
indicators.purpose: Used in the afternoon phase to confirm the gamma-unwind direction is self-consistent (not a 5-second noise spike). 12 bars = 1 minute — matches the 30-90 second hold time. The original strategy used volume_surge > 1.5x as confirmation; on the NIFTY index, 1-minute price momentum is a cleaner and more available confirmation signal.

indicators.name: roll_high_12 / roll_low_12
indicators.purpose: 1-minute rolling range used as the afternoon breakout level. When close > roll_high_12, price has broken the prior-minute candle structure to the upside — a sign that de-hedging momentum has begun. Same rationale for PE on the downside. 12-bar window chosen to match our hold time (18 bars max) so the signal captures fresh, recent structure.

conditions: MORNING (09:20-13:30): dist_to_max_oi < -dist_threshold AND mom_12 >= 0 (price below max-OI and starting to turn)
OR AFTERNOON (13:30-15:25): close > roll_high_12 AND mom_12 > 0 (upside breakout with momentum)
buy_ce.confirmation: Morning: price is below pin level with 1-min momentum non-negative (reversion beginning). Afternoon: price has closed above the prior-1-minute candle range top.

conditions: MORNING (09:20-13:30): dist_to_max_oi > dist_threshold AND mom_12 <= 0 (price above max-OI and starting to turn)
OR AFTERNOON (13:30-15:25): close < roll_low_12 AND mom_12 < 0 (downside breakout with momentum)
buy_pe.confirmation: Morning: price above pin level with 1-min momentum non-positive. Afternoon: close below prior-1-minute candle range bottom.

exit.stop_rationale: Morning mean-reversion: if NIFTY continues away from the max-OI strike for another 8+ spot pts (4 option pts at delta 0.5), the gamma-hedging supply/demand is being overwhelmed by directional flow and the pin thesis is invalid. Afternoon breakout: if the de-hedging momentum stalls immediately and reverses 8 spot pts, it was a false break. 4 pts = 8 spot pts at delta 0.5 is the correct threshold for both phases at the 30-90s hold horizon.
exit.target_rationale: Morning: NIFTY mean-reversion bounces from 25-40 pt deviations typically cover 15-25 spot pts in the first 60 seconds — capturing 14 spot pts (7 option pts) represents ~50-60% of the first leg. Afternoon: gamma-unwind bursts cover 15-30 spot pts in 30-60 seconds; 7 pts = 14 spot pts captures approximately half the expected move. R:R = 1:1.75.
exit.eod_rule: flatten at 15:25 IST (absolute; expiry-day positions must not be held into final 5 minutes)

filters.vix_filter: 12.0 <= VIX <= 25.0 — below 12 gamma effects are too small (very low vol, thin OI), above 25 expiry pinning breaks down as directional flow overwhelms hedgers
filters.time_filter: morning phase 09:20-13:30 (mean-reversion toward pin); afternoon phase 13:30-15:25 (gamma unwind breakout)
filters.volume_filter: none — NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index volume on expiry is structurally higher; no per-bar filter needed
filters.trend_filter: morning: contrarian (fade deviation from max-OI). afternoon: trend-following (ride de-hedging burst)
filters.spread_filter: none — limit orders at candle close prices
filters.event_filter: expiry_day_only = True (detected via option_df where expiry == session_date)

edge.edge_decay_risk: Medium — weekly expiry gamma effects are smaller than monthly (less OI), and algo participation on expiry is increasing. The two-phase structure (morning pin + afternoon unwind) is more sophisticated than simple 'sell gamma on expiry' and should be more durable.

adaptation_notes: Original strategy used 1-min bars with 15-45 minute hold times and required explicit max pain calculation (iterating all strikes to minimize option buyer P&L). Adapted as: (1) Replaced full max-pain computation with max-OI strike — computationally tractable from option_df and highly correlated with true max pain. (2) Hold time compressed from 15-45 min to 30-90 seconds — we catch only the FIRST short burst of each phase rather than the full move. (3) Added mom_12 (1-min momentum) as a microstructure confirmation replacing the original's volume_surge > 1.5x criterion — index volume at 5-second resolution is too noisy for ratio comparisons. (4) Afternoon breakout uses roll_high_12/roll_low_12 rather than the original's 'high/low of last 30 bars' — compressed from 30-min to 1-min range because at 5s resolution we detect the burst beginning, not the full breakout from a multi-hour range. (5) Expiry detection from option_df (expiry == session_date) requires no external calendar.
weaknesses: Max-OI strike is only a proxy for true max pain. If heavy hedging is distributed across 2-3 strikes (not concentrated), the signal may be misleading.
On weekly expiry with low OI, gamma effects are much weaker than monthly expiry — signal quality is heterogeneous across Thursday types.
Only fires on expiry days (~52-60 trading days per year for combined NIFTY/BANKNIFTY weeklies + monthlies), limiting backtest data density.
option_df must be populated with OI data for expiry detection and max-OI computation to work; empty option_df returns zero signals.

_source.original_stop: 15 bps from max pain distance (morning); 15 bps from entry (afternoon)
